name: zmodel_light_set_active_lights
description: zModel_Light::SetActiveLights builds active-light vertex attributes for hardware and software render paths, including point-light attr1, fog/target attr0, and hardware fog attr2 side effects.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel lighting helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel lighting/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x487f10 shows the hardware path precomputes per-active-light distance/range data, normalizes the supplied surface normal, accumulates point lights into g_Clip_PolyAttr1, accumulates hardware fog-target lights into g_Clip_PolyAttr2, commits fog target state, and returns attr/fog result flags while updating lightFlags and lightingMode.

The native smoke verifies hardware fog-target accumulation and committed fog color, software fog-weight attr0 scaling, point-light attr1 accumulation with per-poly normals, lightingMode updates, and the no-active-light zero-result path.
